parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: A client-generated token to ensure request idempotence. The token must be unique for each request. It can contain a maximum of 64 ASCII characters.

sub_parameters.name: EffectiveType
sub_parameters.description: The type of the effective scope. Valid value: *account*.

sub_parameters.name: Scope
sub_parameters.description: The values for the scope, which depend on the value of `EffectiveType`. If `EffectiveType` is set to `account`, this parameter is a list of account IDs.

parameters.name: ZoneId
parameters.description: The unique ID of the zone.
